metadata.description: Agent skill for the scout CLI — measure a mobile repository across its git history

plugins.name: scout
plugins.description: Teaches the agent when and how to reach for the scout CLI. Ships as an umbrella skill plus one dedicated sub-skill per subcommand (scout-types, scout-files, scout-pattern, scout-loc, scout-build-settings) — config file shapes, output JSON shapes, cross-commit analysis, and the footguns that come with checking out historical commits
